title: Socket path and UDS gRPC connector duplicated across all three binaries
description:
The workload socket path convention `/run/user/{uid}/persona/workload.sock` is constructed independently in three places:
- personad/src/main.rs:53-54  (the daemon that BINDS it)
- persona/src/main.rs:55-59   socket_path()
- persona-nmh/src/main.rs:61-64  socket_path()

The tonic-over-Unix-socket channel setup (Endpoint::try_from("http://[::]:50051") + connect_with_connector + service_fn + TokioIo) is duplicated in two:
- persona/src/main.rs:62-90   connect_to_daemon()
- persona-nmh/src/main.rs:109-131  inside fetch_jwt()

What goes wrong: the daemon and its clients agree on the socket path only by coincidence of three identical format! strings. Change the convention in one (add an env override, move to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, add a per-trust-domain suffix) and the clients silently look in the wrong place — the failure is 'personad socket not found', pointing the user at the daemon rather than at the mismatch. The dummy URI and the connector closure are pure copy-paste with no variation between the two copies.

Rewrite: move both into persona-core (or persona-grpc, which both clients already depend on) as two small functions — `pub fn workload_socket_path() -> PathBuf` and `pub async fn connect(path: &Path) -> Result<Channel>`. Three call sites collapse to one line each; this is net deletion of ~35 duplicated lines, not a new abstraction layer.

Keep persona/src/main.rs:69-74's friendly 'Is personad running?' bail at the CLI, since persona-nmh must not write that to stdout.
close_reason: Duplicate of persona-5s4b.12 (same defect, filed by a second review agent from a different angle). Merged during review triage; reopen if the angle in this issue is not covered there.
